skill.summary: 联网搜索统一接口 - 一个接口自动选择最优服务商（百炼/Tavily/火山引擎），支持降级、合并、告警

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of unified-web-search, providing a unified interface for online search across multiple providers (Bailian, Tavily, Volcengine).
- Automatically selects the optimal provider, supports fallback, result merging, and alerts.
- Allows tuning of search intensity (quick/normal/deep), time freshness, and site filters.
- Simple API with structured result including answer and source list.
- Requires at least one API key configuration before use.
